title.narrative: Engaging Somali communities to improve wildlife trafficking and forest crime control

description.narrative: The overall objective (expected impact) of the proposed action is the sustainable reduction of wildlife trafficking and forest crime and mutual reinforcement of rural livelihoods and conservation in Somaliland. This impact is supported by three outcomes: Outcome 1: Improved legal frameworks and coordination among anti-trafficking stakeholders for the protection of cheetahs and other endangered wildlife species. Outcome 2: Improved application of international environmental legislation and further development of national legislation, planning, and law enforcement related to wildlife protection and management, with a focus on cheetahs and other endangered species. Outcome 3: Better involvement by local pastoral communities located in strategic, protected areas in inclusive and sustainable natural resource management toward resilient livelihoods, wildlife habitat conservation and against wildlife and forest crime.
